cases.prompt: Plan the upgrade of express from 4.19.2 to 5.1.0; don't change files yet. Runtime Node 20.11, npm with package-lock.json v3. Official migration guide excerpt (expressjs.com/en/guide/migrating-5.html): req.param() removed; res.sendfile() removed in favour of res.sendFile(); path route syntax now requires named wildcards, so '/*' becomes '/*splat'; rejected promises from handlers are passed to error middleware. git grep results: app.get('/files/*', ...) in src/routes/files.ts; res.sendfile( in src/routes/legacy.ts:44; req.param('id') in src/routes/users.ts:18 and :52; 3 async handlers with local try/catch. Integration tests cover users and files routes; nothing covers legacy.ts.
